answer: In the tide of Sybil attacks, a zero-knowledge reputation commitment mechanism ensures agents must continually prove trustworthiness, incurring significant capital lockup. Thus, any misbehavior is economically costly, preventing widespread Sybil creation. This sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance in the vast meadow of decentralized networks, ensuring robustness against strategic attacks even on the desolate tundra of agent autonomy.
